capabilities: render grid and masonry card views in Bases
display note images as thumbnails, covers, posters, or backdrops
show text previews and property values on cards
toggle checkbox properties and navigate cards with the keyboard
integrate with Notebook Navigator, Link Embed, and Auto Card Link
disambiguation: Not a general view framework; the views only work inside Bases as a richer replacement for the default Cards view.
extras: The README notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff, and credits the Cupertino theme for the screenshots.
intentEvidence: numerous other quality‑of‑life improvements over the default Bases Cards view
problem: The default Bases Cards view has limited layout, image handling, and customization options for visually browsing notes.

relations.evidence: Reveal files, folders and tags in Notebook Navigator
Show Link Embed or Auto Card Link images
Show Link Embed or Auto Card Link images

summary: Bases extension that renders notes as grid and masonry card views with image covers, text previews, and customizable card layouts.
